europass.title: Free Europass CV Builder — Create a Europass CV Online
europass.description: Build a Europass CV free online: the EU standard layout, CEFR language levels, PDF or Word download. No sign-up.
europass.h2: The EU standard CV format, filled in and downloaded in minutes
europass.intro: Europass is the curriculum vitae format defined by the European Union. It sets a fixed order of sections and one shared way of stating language ability, so a recruiter in Lisbon reads a CV from Tallinn without having to decode its layout first. Our builder produces that format free, with no account.
europass.whoTitle: Who asks for a Europass CV
europass.whoBody: It is the expected format across most EU public-sector recruitment, for many university and research posts, for EU institutions and agencies, and for mobility and traineeship programmes. Private employers in several member states accept it as a matter of course. Outside those cases a conventional CV usually reads better — Europass is a standard, not an upgrade.
sections: Personal information — name, contact details, and the city and country you are based in
Work experience — reverse chronological, each entry with its period, employer and what you actually did
Education and training — qualifications with the awarding institution and dates
Language skills — your mother tongue plus every other language, stated on the CEFR scale
Digital skills — the tools and systems you work with
Other — driving licence, publications, certifications and volunteering, where relevant
europass.cefrTitle: Language levels on the CEFR scale
europass.cefrIntro: This is the part of Europass employers compare directly, and the part candidates most often overstate. The scale runs from A1 to C2. Pick the level you could defend in an interview conducted in that language.
steps: Fill in the form — experience, education, skills and languages.
Pick the Europass template; the layout and section order follow the standard.
Download as PDF, or as .docx when the employer asks for Word.

faqs.q: Is a Europass CV free to make?
faqs.a: Yes. This builder produces one free, with no sign-up and no watermark, and exports to PDF or Word.

faqs.q: Do I have to use Europass?
faqs.a: Only where it is asked for — EU public-sector roles, research posts, EU institutions and mobility programmes. Elsewhere a conventional CV usually reads better.

faqs.q: Should I send PDF or Word?
faqs.a: Send what the advert asks for. If it does not say, PDF preserves the layout; .docx is parsed more reliably by some recruitment systems.

faqs.q: How do I choose my CEFR level?
faqs.a: Take the level you could sustain in an interview held in that language. Overstating it is exposed in the first minutes of a call.
